## MCP - Mathpix

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/mathpix

**Description:** OCR mathematique via Mathpix API. Convertit images de formules/equations en LaTeX, MathML, AsciiMath.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["image_url|image_base64", "mathpix_app_id", "mathpix_app_key"],
  "optional": ["user_id", "guild_id", "user_request"],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID utilisateur pour tracabilite" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID serveur Discord" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "Requete originale de l'utilisateur" },
    "image_url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL de l'image avec equations" },
    "image_base64": { "type": "string", "description": "Image encodee en base64" },
    "mathpix_app_id": { "type": "string", "description": "Mathpix App ID" },
    "mathpix_app_key": { "type": "string", "description": "Mathpix App Key" },
    "formats": { "type": "array", "description": "Formats de sortie", "default": ["latex_styled", "text", "data"] },
    "include_asciimath": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "include_latex": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "include_mathml": { "type": "boolean", "default": false },
    "include_svg": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }
  }
}
```

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": true,
  "accepts_media": true,
  "output_fields": ["latex", "text", "confidence", "asciimath", "mathml"],
  "domain": "math_ocr"
}
```
